purpose: What is known about the four generations no pinned build script produces. sources/pancreas.json pins its dataset; this file does not pin these four, and says exactly what it records instead.
recorded: observed.generation_sha256, observed.file_count and observed.total_bytes, computed over exports/<id>/ excluding default.cellucid-session and state-snapshots.json, by the same function tests/catalog-contract.test.mjs measures the Pancreas generation with.

producer.cellucid_data_version, copied out of exports/<id>/dataset_identity.json. cellucid.prepare() writes its own cellucid.__version__ into that field (cellucid-python, src/cellucid/prepare_data/_generation.py), so it is the exporter naming itself at the moment it wrote the directory.

notebook_reported_file_count, transcribed from the committed output of the export notebook's own file census. It agrees with observed.file_count for all four, which ties each published directory to one committed notebook run.
source.size_bytes, the size the preparation notebook recorded for the .h5ad it read, carried in uns.cellucid_build.source_bytes.
not_proved: That re-running the notebooks would produce these bytes again. Nothing here is a build contract; it is a description of artifacts already in the repository.

That the recorded producer version is true. It is the export's own statement about itself, with nothing outside the export corroborating it, unlike sources/pancreas.json, which hashes every producer module the export path executes.
Which bytes the export was built from. A matching file size is not a matching file.
That the named notebooks produced these directories. The file-count agreement is evidence, not identity: two runs differing only in coordinate values would agree on it.
not_recoverable: A checksum of any source .h5ad. None was taken while these generations were built and none can be reconstructed now, because the export format stores no cell barcodes and no source digest.

A pinned interpreter, library set, BLAS configuration or thread count. The notebooks record anndata, scanpy and numpy versions in the intermediate .h5ad, which is untracked and lives outside this repository; nothing records umap-learn, whose version governs the embeddings.
Bit-exact embeddings. The notebooks fix random_state=0 but run an approximate neighbour search above 4,096 cells with no thread pinning, so equal inputs need not give equal coordinates.
The sources themselves. They are not redistributable from here, so these four generations can be rebuilt only with access to the .anndatas/ tree they were prepared from.
